messages:
Marta (Partner Eng): Quick heads-up — IntegratorCorp's marketplace private image deploy to GovCloud is failing on image key unwrap with our KMS proxy. Customer is blocked for go-live on Tuesday. Ping @Sam for a runtime trace? :rotating_light:

Ravi (SI PM): When did this start? any CI/deploy logs?

IntegratorCorp-ops: It started after we rotated the KMS key this morning. Error from node: 'failed to unwrap key: permission denied'. No HSM on our side, just AWS KMS in their account.

Lia (Field Eng): Can you paste the kubelet/containerd startup log and the image manifest + digest? Also confirm marketplace flow: subscribed AMI vs private AMI install?

IntegratorCorp-ops: Pasting quick snippet:
```\nkubelet: failed to decrypt: unwrap failed: status=403\ncontainerd: pull for registry.marketplace/integratorcorp/edge:prod-2026-03-21 failed\nmanifest digest: sha256:abcd1234efgh5678\n```
We used marketplace private-AMI provisioning.

Sasha (Solutions): This sounds like the proxy role/trust policy issue we've hit before — missing sts:AssumeRole or missing kms:Decrypt in the partner's policy. @Sam does the proxy log show a 403 coming back from AWS KMS?

Sam (Eng Runtime): Confirmed from traces: our KMS proxy returned AccessDenied from AWS KMS. The assume-role call to arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/redwood-kms-proxy-IntegratorCorp returned AccessDenied. I need the partner to verify the trust policy includes our proxy principal. I can escalate to infra if it looks like our role ARN is wrong.

Jules (Sales): FYI customer is on a tight timeline — we need a sync by EOD tomorrow or they push pilot. Can SRE/infra prioritize this?

DeployBot: New runbook created: /runbooks/partners/integratorcorp-kms-checklist (https://internal.runbooks/redwood/integratorcorp-kms-checklist).

Marta (Partner Eng): Action items: 1) IntegratorCorp to update IAM trust policy to include arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/proxy principal (sample policy attached in runbook). 2) Partner redeploy after policy update. 3) @Sam to confirm successful Decrypt in proxy logs. I'll schedule a 1pm PT check-in. @IntegratorCorp-ops please confirm when policy is applied.

IntegratorCorp-ops: Applying policy now, will ping when done (should be ~20m). Posting the policy we applied in the channel once complete.

Sam (Eng Runtime): I'll tail the proxy logs and post a confirmation when I see a successful Decrypt handshake. Note: if trust-policy fix doesn't work, fallback plan is to roll back to previous key or apply a small proxy patch to accept external HSM thumbprints — that will require a patch release and a canary.

Lia (Field Eng): If we need the hotfix, propose canary steps: 1) push image to a dedicated node pool, 2) patch helm values to mount temporary key, 3) monitor token unwrap. I can prepare helm changes now.

Marta (Partner Eng): Thanks — please update this thread when you have logs/policy applied. I'll open an incident if unresolved by 1pm PT. :white_check_mark:
